Record Class ServerSessionRegistry.SessionSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.controller.server.ServerSessionRegistry.SessionSnapshot
Record Components:
sessionId - the unique session ID
connection - the active network connection link
user - the user model (null if unauthenticated)
phase - the current session phase
lobbyId - the lobby ID (null if not in lobby)
gameId - the game ID (null if not in game)
lastPongAt - the timestamp of the last recorded network pong
timedOut - true if the duration since last pong exceeds the threshold timeout limit
Enclosing class:
ServerSessionRegistry
public static record ServerSessionRegistry.SessionSnapshot(String sessionId, ClientConnection connection, User user, ServerSessionRegistry.Phase phase, Integer lobbyId, Integer gameId, long lastPongAt, boolean timedOut) extends Record
Immutable snapshot representation of a session state, suitable for secure access and iterations.
